title: 5 Signs Your Business Needs a Content Strategy
content: Most businesses create content reactively — they post when they remember to, write what feels right in the moment, and wonder why nothing gains traction. Here are five signs you need an actual content strategy. Sign 1: You are posting inconsistently. One week you post every day,done, you have no data to build on. Sign 3: Every piece of content starts from scratch. If you are writing new ideas daily without repurposing, you are wasting 70 percent of your effort. Sign 4: Your content does not lead anywhere. Every post should point somewhere — a landing page, a lead magnet, a DM, a booking link. If posts are just posts, they are decoration. Sign 5: You are saying the same things as everyone else. If your content could belong to any business in your industry, it is not differentiated enough. A real strategy fixes all five.
